environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has NO NAT Gateway, NO VPC endpoints for S3/SSM/CloudWatch, and NO internet gateway route in the private route table. The only ingress path is via an internal ALB (scheme: internal) whose target group is registered to the Fargate tasks. The VPC's private subnet route table (rtb-0a3f7c9e2d) contains only a local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 destination. Security group sg-0ef82a4b on the ENI allows inbound TCP/8080 from sg-0cc91d3a (the internal ALB SG) only, and allows NO outbound rules except to the internal ALB CIDR on ephemeral ports for response traffic. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero packets to any destination outside 10.0.0.0/16 in the last 90 days.

config.route_table: rtb-0a3f7c9e2d: local route only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local), no NAT, no IGW
config.security_group_inbound: TCP/8080 from sg-0cc91d3a (internal ALB SG) only
config.security_group_outbound: TCP ephemeral ports to 10.0.0.0/20 (ALB subnet) only
config.vpc_flow_logs: enabled, zero external traffic observed in 90 days
